reservations.title: Car rental in Málaga

start_place.name: Málaga Airport
start_place.address: Avenida del Comandante García Morato, s/n, 29004 Málaga

end_place.name: Seville Santa Justa Train Station
end_place.address: Avenida de Kansas City, s/n, 41007 Sevilla

reservations.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before pick-up. If you cancel less than 48 hours before pick-up, you will be refunded the price you paid minus the cost of 3 days' rental. There is no refund for no-shows or for unused rental days.

details.pickup: The Avis desk is in the Arrivals hall of Terminal 3, Level 0. After completing the paperwork, collect your car from car park P2, Level 0.
details.dropoff: Return the car to the Avis bays in the station's underground car park, Level -1, and hand in the keys at the Avis office in the station's main hall.

notes: Supplier is Avis; Rentalcars.com booking reference 337289992. One-way rental from Málaga Airport to Seville Santa Justa, one-way fee included.
